label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 125

obligations.text:
Approval of codes prepared under sections 121 to 124A
(1)
When a code is prepared under section 121, 122, 123 , 124 or 124A—
(a)
the Commission must submit the final version to the Secretary of State, and
(b)
the Secretary of State must lay the code before Parliament.

(3)
If, within the 40-day period, either House of Parliament resolves not to approve a code prepared under section 121, 122, 123 , 124 or 124A, the Commission must not issue the code.

(4)
If no such resolution is made within that period—
(a)
the Commission must issue the code, and
(b)
the code comes into force at the end of the period of 21 days beginning with the day on which it is issued.

(5)
If the Commission is prevented by subsection (3) from issuing a code that is not a replacement code, the Commission must prepare another version of the code.
